Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class SharedGameTestSupport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.SharedGameTestSupport
Direct Known Subclasses:
GameTestSupport
abstract class SharedGameTestSupport extends Object
Supplies vanilla and loader-neutral setup and assertions to both GameTest suites.

      static net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult clickBlock(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit)
      Dispatches a player's right-click on a block as vanilla does for a player whose block use is skipped (sneaking with an item in hand, or a block that does nothing on use): the held item's useOn, then, when that passes, GameTestSupport.useItem(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand). The loader's block-use event and the block's own use do not run.
